title: The Best Black Friday AirPods Deals Still Available
content:
Black Friday season is always the best time of year to shop for AirPods, and this year Amazon has great discounts on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with Amazon. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

The AirPods Pro 3 are available for $149.00, down from $249.00. This is a massive $100 discount on the AirPods Pro 3, and one of the overall best Black Friday deals this year.

$100 OFF
AirPods Pro 3 for $149.00


For the AirPods Max 2, Amazon has every color on sale for $419.00, down from $549.00. This beats the deal from earlier in the month by about $30, and it's an overall solid second-best price on the headphones.

$130 OFF
AirPods Max 2 for $419.00


You can check out our main post on all of the best Apple Black Friday deals for information on sales for Macs, iPads, Apple Watches, and more. If you're on the hunt for more discounts, be sure to visit our Black Friday roundup where we recap the best Apple-related bargains of the month.
